entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Bob. How can I assist you today?
Hi Bob, I'd like to make a return for a VeloBand GPS Tracker I recently purchased.
Certainly, I can absolutely help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Great, one moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th. You're well within the return window.
Oh, good. I was a bit worried since it's been a few weeks.
No problem at all! Our policy allows returns for up to 90 days, so you have plenty of time. I can go ahead and email you a prepaid return label right now. Would you like me to do that?
Yes, that would be perfect. Thank you.
Alright, I've just sent that over. Also, I see you're a VIP member with us. As a small thank you for trying out the new VeloBand, I've added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Wow, I wasn't expecting that! Thank you so much, Bob. That's very generous.

It's my pleasure. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund processed to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can do for you?
No, that's everything. You've made this very easy.
Happy to help! Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
